### 💡 Proposed Tool / Feature Description
A clear and concise description of what the tool should do and how it helps developers.

### 🌐 Related Live Website
Reference: [OmniTools](https://www.devomnitools.com)

### 🛠️ Key Capabilities & Inputs
- **Input Types:** (e.g. JSON, SQL, Hex, Text, File)
- **Output Types:** (e.g. Formatted code, Table, Image, Export file)
- **Settings / Options:** (e.g. Dark mode, Minification level, Presets)

### 🔒 Client-Side Guarantee
- [ ] Must run 100% in-browser (zero server uploads, fully private)

### 📚 References or Similar Tools (Optional)
Links or screenshots of existing tools or specifications.
